% equation* as in the PDF. A \ref to its \label gives the section's number.
% A split's second column starts with {}, so its relation is spaced as one.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\begin{document}
\section{S}
\begin{equation*} a = b \label{eq:s} \end{equation*}
\begin{equation*} \begin{split} a &= b \\ &= c \end{split} \end{equation*}
See \ref{eq:s}.
\end{document}
